_all: Run on a branch per manifest; check first: python3 scripts/crate_split/g7/check.py scripts/crate_split/g7/<crate>.toml must print `violations 0`.

Item cuts: put each item list in a mapall.json-style map {items:{"old::Item":"new::mod"}} and run itemmove.py (rewrites crate:: and medulla_<src>:: paths workspace-wide); file cuts are git mv plus the mod line.

Module moves: create the target crate (Cargo.toml, lib.rs with #![deny(missing_docs)] like its siblings), then move each unit in `order` with move_leaf_modules.py --from <source> --to <target> after adding the unit paths to boundaries.toml moves (already there). No re-exports of old paths; every `use` is rewritten.
#[path] includes: list_mods treats a file a top-level module includes with #[path] as part of that module; move it with it.
macro_export macros move with the module that defines them; rewrite `$crate::` to the new crate and callers' `medulla_<src>::name!` to `medulla_<target>::name!`.
Features: forward every cfg(feature) the moved units test (move_leaf_modules forwards features it sees; check `cargo check -p <target> --all-features`).
Test fixtures live with the lowest crate whose tests use them; a test module that needs a higher crate moves up with the cut listed here.
medulla-query: medulla-query is removed when the last unit moves; plan_scope goes to medulla-table-store. Order: table-schema has no deps, so it may move first; the listed order (top-down) also works.
medulla-compute: solve -> medulla-decision-policy and reasoning* -> medulla-reasoner already have boundaries rows; medulla-compute keeps parser, ast, assemble, datascience, sketch and the small leaves.
medulla-tsdb uses finance::market and finance::signals: rewrite to medulla_finance_market (tsdb sits above finance-market).
medulla-numeric: risk stays in medulla-numeric (tsdb, finance-market and decision-stats share it); calibration and evaluation stay (finance-quant and plan use them).
medulla-plan: uql::serve and uql::tests stay in medulla-plan (the composer); medulla-uql keeps parser, grammar, lexer, print, diag.
fixture/oracle become pub test-support modules of medulla-exec behind feature `test-support`; upper crates dev-depend on medulla-exec with that feature.
medulla-server: Ranks come from modgraph.py with dispatch, dispatch::request_boundary and split_tests expanded; `use super::*` globs count only the names the importing code uses, and names a module imports from other crates are not edges.

Cuts first, in order, each its own commit inside medulla-server: dispatch::shared, the seam wrappers, the propose_native_mutation path, validate_nested_msgpack, the re-entry port, the four e2e test moves, the lib.rs tests file. After them check.py's edges are all downward.

The re-entry port is the only behaviour-sensitive cut: three production call sites switch from a direct call to the server-api DispatchApi seam, so every test state that reaches them must carry the DispatchSeam (test_support builders, lib tests' test_state*, split_tests state helpers). Startup already installs it. Run the dispatch, consensus, SPARQL update and identity tests after this cut, not only check.

Nested units keep their path: medulla_server_graph::dispatch::graph_pipeline, medulla_server_router::dispatch::request_boundary, medulla_server_cluster_tests::split_tests::raft_cluster (move_nested_modules.py). dispatch.rs and split_tests.rs end empty in medulla-server and are deleted with their mod lines.

Tests crates (served, store, cluster) are lib crates whose modules are all #[cfg(test)]; they depend on medulla-server and the router. Items their tests name through crate:: become pub in the owning crate (vis_fix.py).
Moves in order: tests crates, then medulla-server-router, consensus and identity, graph, lake and obs. Build after each target crate.
medulla-h-query: query::seam (QuerySeam, 72 lines) moves to medulla-server (the composition root that installs it): it names query, semantic_index_runtime and mining, so no handler crate can own it.

medulla-h-query (F9a) depends on medulla-h-sparql and medulla-h-retrieve (F9); medulla-h-mining (F9b) depends on medulla-h-query (mining/input.rs runs the served UnifiedQuery path). The other F9 handler crates stay siblings with no edges to these.
medulla-sql: crates/medulla-sql/tests moves whole to the new medulla-sql-tests crate (unit `@tests`): Cargo.toml with an empty lib, the old dev-dependencies as dependencies plus medulla-sql and medulla-sql-lang; test files keep their names.

medulla-sql-lang gets the sql:: module path (medulla_sql_lang::sql::classify, ::pgq, ::plpgsql, ...). sql/mod.rs re-exports of moved items are deleted and every caller is rewritten (pgwire, plan, h-query, h-txn, h-decide, kernel, server-api).
plpgsql::try_exec_call and the pgfamily/classify items the executor calls are pub(super) today: widen to pub.
medulla-wire: No cuts: the units only point at wire, broker_wire and sql_wire_auth, which form medulla-wire-core. medulla-wire-msg and medulla-wire are siblings at F9 with no edges between them.
WireSeam stays in medulla_wire_core::wire; seams_install names it there.
medulla-raft: harness modules join medulla-raft-xshard; raft core tests that use a harness move with it.
medulla-store: enrichment_budget, enrichment_top_up and both statecharts stay in medulla-store: store_mutation and store_read call them.
medulla-server-api: Partial manifest: the cuts before the `open` entry are mechanical; the moves are valid only after the open entry is resolved.
